title: A robust and adaptive MPC formulation for Gaussian process models
abstract: arXiv:2507.02098v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: In this paper, we present a robust and adaptive model predictive control (MPC) framework for uncertain nonlinear systems affected by bounded disturbances and unmodeled nonlinearities. We use Gaussian Processes (GPs) to learn the uncertain dynamics based on noisy measurements, including those collected during system operation. As a key contribution, we derive robust predictions for GP models using contraction metrics, which are incorporated in the MPC formulation. The proposed design guarantees recursive feasibility, robust constraint satisfaction and convergence to a reference state, with high probability. We provide a numerical example of a planar quadrotor subject to difficult-to-model ground effects, which highlights significant improvements achieved through the proposed robust prediction method and through online learning.

translated_title: 一种针对高斯过程模型的鲁棒自适应模型预测控制方法
translated_abstract: 本文针对受有界扰动和未建模非线性影响的非线性不确定系统，提出了一种鲁棒且自适应的模型预测控制（MPC）框架。我们使用高斯过程（GP）基于含噪测量数据（包括系统运行过程中采集的数据）来学习不确定的动力学特性。作为一项关键贡献，我们利用收缩度量推导出高斯过程模型的鲁棒预测，并将其纳入MPC设计中。所提出的设计以高概率保证递归可行性、鲁棒约束满足以及收敛到参考状态。我们提供了一个受难以建模的地面效应影响的平面四旋翼飞行器数值算例，展示了所提出的鲁棒预测方法和在线学习所取得的显著性能提升。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于收缩度量推导高斯过程鲁棒预测的鲁棒自适应模型预测控制框架，以高概率保证递归可行性、鲁棒约束满足和收敛性，并通过在线学习实现显著性能提升。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a robust and adaptive MPC framework that derives robust Gaussian process predictions using contraction metrics, guaranteeing recursive feasibility, robust constraint satisfaction, and convergence with high probability, while online learning achieves significant performance improvements.
